# Eduvance — AI-Powered Adaptive Exam Preparation

> Eduvance is a web application that helps students prepare for exams using AI-powered adaptive learning. It analyzes your syllabus, exam schedule, and study progress to decide what to study, when, and for how long.

## Features

- [Adaptive Study Planner](https://eduvance-mmra.vercel.app/planner) — AI-generated study schedules based on exam dates and weak topics
- [Smart Quizzes](https://eduvance-mmra.vercel.app/quiz) — AI-generated questions specific to your uploaded syllabus topics
- [Progress Tracking](https://eduvance-mmra.vercel.app/progress) — Track mastery across subjects and topics
- [Syllabus Analysis](https://eduvance-mmra.vercel.app/syllabus) — Upload your syllabus and Eduvance extracts topics automatically
- [Performance Analytics](https://eduvance-mmra.vercel.app/analytics) — Detailed insights into your study patterns

## How It Works

1. Upload your syllabus and exam timetable
2. Eduvance analyzes topics and prioritizes based on exam weight
3. Follow the AI-generated study plan
4. Take quizzes to test understanding
5. The system adapts your plan based on quiz performance
